software / Deployment

Vercel

Review a web change on a preview before releasing it.

VOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Vercel provides deployment and hosting capabilities for web applications, including Git-based previews and server-side functions. We can use it to create a reviewable release process for a website or SaaS frontend. Stakeholders can inspect a preview, engineering can verify environment configuration, and an agreed release can move to the production domain with a documented recovery path.

Useful outputs

  • Preview and production environments
  • Domain and environment configuration
  • Release, monitoring, and recovery instructions

Where we can apply it

  • Website release: pull request → preview review → production deployment.
  • SaaS frontend: application build → backend integration → protected release.
  • Content update: approved edit → preview verification → versioned publication.
01

Use case 1

Publish responsive service websites and supported web application frameworks.

02

Use case 2

Create review previews for content, interface, and product changes.

03

Use case 3

Host suitable application functions and connect authorized backend services.

Inputs we need

  • Application repository and build configuration
  • Domain ownership and environment requirements
  • Release reviewers and acceptance criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Configure the project's build and authorized environment variables.
  • Review previews and verify the principal user journeys.
  • Connect the production domain and document deployment recovery procedures.

Expert review points

  • Check preview access and production credential boundaries.
  • Review function constraints and usage forecasts for the selected plan.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
